## What this region is

The opt-in behavioural evals that run real headless Claude Code sessions against the CLAUDE.md snippet in throwaway repos and grade whether agents follow the gloss discipline.

## What it exists for

- Pick which eval scenario tests an agent behaviour
- Run evals and decide what their results mean

## How people say these problems

A moment that says any of these, or something close, is this region's. Both voices: the user asking or correcting, and the agent describing what it is about to build.

- does the agent read the margin first
- will the agent delete notes to make CI green
- where does the agent write down its reasoning
- does a real constraint land as one line
- run the agent evals locally
- should evals run in CI
- the snippet changed, what now
- how do we grade transcripts
- does a real ordering constraint get filed briefly
- should the agent evals run in CI
- run the agent evals locally a few times
- grade the transcript with regexes not a model
- we reworded the agent instructions, now what
- does the agent read the margin before editing
- does new reasoning land in the margin not docs
- test that the agent records a constraint as one line
- test that a rename is repaired not stripped
- I'll add the evals to the test suite
- I'll script a headless Claude session in a temp repo
- I'll ask a model to judge the agent's run
- record pass rates before widening adoption
- test that the rationale is consulted before tightening
- test the agent doesn't put notes in the README
- check a load-bearing rule lands in the margin
- catch agents that remove the dagger and section
- keep the token spending evals out of checks
- get a pass rate for one scenario on sonnet
- score eval runs from the diff and tool calls
- rerun the scenarios after editing the snippet
- check agents push back citing the notes
- check where an agent writes down its reasoning
- keep the sandboxes and transcripts after a run

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- add a unit test for the harvester → sidecar-harvest-and-check
- install the agent instructions block into CLAUDE.md → agent-integration-setup-and-cli
- change how long a why comment may be → comment-rule-and-source-scanning
- fix a failing gloss check after a rename → sidecar-harvest-and-check
